name: 75119 · Ennis, TX
findings: ZIP 75119 (Ennis) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75119 (Ennis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75119 (Ennis) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.
